name: Hostname Configured
description: Device must have a hostname configured

name: Telnet Disabled
description: Telnet must not be permitted as a transport input on VTY lines

name: Logging Enabled
description: Device should send logs to a logging/syslog host

name: NTP Configured
description: Device should synchronize time with an NTP server

name: AAA Enabled
description: AAA new-model must be enabled for centralized authentication

name: Banner Configured
description: A login/MOTD banner should be configured

name: SNMP Configured
description: SNMP community/server should be configured for monitoring

name: Interface Descriptions Present
description: At least one interface must have a description configured

name: All Interfaces Have IP Address
description: At least one interface must have an IPv4 address assigned (not just 'no ip address')
